title: Emergency Contact Update Checklist
subtitle: Capture contact priority, relationship, phone route, and release authority; confirm effective date and prior record supersession.
description: Emergency Contact Update records contact priority, relationship, phone route, release authority, effective date, and prior record supersession. Emergency Contact Update evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this emergency contact update stage-gated verification when staff must document contact priority and relationship. Reconcile phone route, release authority, effective date, and prior record supersession before the emergency contact update handoff. Use identity-verification evidence, the prior contact snapshot, custody or release restriction reference, confirmation message, effective-date audit, and supersession log. Ask the assigned emergency contact update reviewer to confirm contact priority against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Emergency Contact Update contact and reference
sections.guidance: Preserve contact priority, relationship, phone and alternate route, release authority, effective date, identity verification, and superseded-record handling.

blocks.label: Emergency Contact Update people and reference

sections.title: Emergency Contact Update checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current emergency contact update facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Emergency Contact Update required checks
items: Contact priority is identified for this record
Relationship matches the current request or source
Phone route is ready for point-of-use staff
Release authority limits or questions are resolved
Effective date is communicated to the responsible person
Prior record supersession is confirmed at handoff
A changed emergency contact update fact is returned for review

sections.title: Emergency Contact Update readiness
sections.guidance: Hold emergency contact update readiness on any failed or pending item.
